description: This file implements a client for performing DuckDuckGo web searches, including HTML parsing, URL decoding, caching, and handling search parameters.

methods.name: decodeHtmlEntities
methods.description: Decodes HTML entities in a string to their corresponding characters.

methods.name: stripHtml
methods.description: Removes HTML tags from a string, leaving only text content.

methods.name: decodeDuckDuckGoUrl
methods.description: Decodes DuckDuckGo redirect URLs to extract the original URL.

methods.name: readHrefAttribute
methods.description: Extracts the href attribute value from a string of HTML tag attributes.

methods.name: isBotChallenge
methods.description: Detects if the HTML response is a bot challenge page.

methods.name: parseDuckDuckGoHtml
methods.description: Parses HTML content from DuckDuckGo search results to extract individual results.

methods.name: runDuckDuckGoSearch
methods.description: Performs a DuckDuckGo search with specified parameters, handles caching, and returns search results.
